hooks.command: cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)}" || exit 0; [ -f context/project.yml ] && [ -f apm.lock.yaml ] || exit 0; if ! (sed -n 's/^ *- \(\.[^ :]*\)$/\1/p' apm.lock.yaml | while read -r p; do [ -e "$p" ] || exit 1; done); then if command -v apm >/dev/null; then apm install --frozen >&2 || exit 1; fi; fi; d=$(ls -d .claude/skills/setup-agent-harness .agents/skills/setup-agent-harness ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:+"$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/skills/setup-agent-harness"} 2>/dev/null | head -1); [ -z "$d" ] || node "$d/scripts/setup.mjs" --gitignore >&2
